name: claude-mem-eve-provider-dev
description: Dev harness for the claude-mem/eve export. Published as part of the root claude-mem package; this package.json only installs eve for typecheck and tests.

scripts.build:types: tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir types --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --strict --skipLibCheck --types node
scripts.check:types: npm run build:types && git diff --exit-code -- types
